summary: On lap completion, fires audio message 55 through the driver data table when the race is active, the track condition state is non-zero, the passed entrant shares the team/constructor ID (field +0x4894) with the player vehicle, and the race phase is not 8.

operations.description: Race-active gate: proceed only when dword_7D0308 (RaceActiveFlag) is non-zero; fired from LapCompletion (caller 0x004BC4E0).
Track-condition gate: require flt_7CF3C8 != 0.0; the packet lists flt_59E440 as a read global, consistent with a zero-threshold constant feeding this comparison.
Teammate gate: require the player vehicle's +0x4894 (dword_7C54E8) to equal the passed entrant's +0x4894 — same team/constructor ID.
Race-phase gate: require dword_7C56A8 != 8 to exclude the phase-8 race state.
Populate a driver data entry via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion (callee 0x004144F0) with message ID 55 and driver/timing parameters.
Insert the populated entry into the shared driver data table via InsertDriverTableEntry (callee 0x00418560), passing flt_5EA618 as the table target.
